annotations.description: The player has Badlands (1 mana) + Chrome Mox (1 mana, imprinting Dark Ritual so it produces B) + Lion's Eye Diamond (0 mana artifact that can be sacrificed for 3 mana). They can cast Burning Wish for 1R (tap Badlands for R, tap Chrome Mox for B... wait, Burning Wish costs {1}{R}). Badlands taps for B or R. Chrome Mox has Dark Ritual exiled, so it taps for B. That gives access to B+R or B+B - enough for Burning Wish (1R = one generic + one red). They could tap Chrome Mox for B (generic) and Badlands for R to cast Burning Wish, fetching a sorcery from the sideboard. Additionally, they could sacrifice LED in response to casting Beseech the Mirror to generate 3 black mana. With Badlands (B) + Chrome Mox (B) + LED (BBB after sac, discarding hand), they could cast Beseech the Mirror (1BBB) bargaining the LED or Chrome Mox. Actually, LED must be sacrificed as part of its activation, not bargained. But they could: tap Badlands for B, tap Chrome Mox for B, sacrifice LED discarding hand for BBB, then cast Beseech the Mirror for 1BBB (they'd have BBBBB, enough) bargaining Chrome Mox. Wait - LED timing: LED can only be activated as an instant, and you'd need to activate it while Beseech is on the stack. The standard line is: cast Beseech the Mirror, hold priority, crack LED for BBB (discarding hand), bargain Chrome Mox. They'd have Badlands (B) + Chrome Mox (B) for 2 mana, then crack LED for BBB more = BBBBB total, Beseech costs 1BBB = 4 mana, so they have enough. This lets them tutor for any card CMC 4 or less and cast it for free - a powerful combo line. Passing the turn with this line available is a significant missed opportunity.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without casting any spells, claiming no playable cards with current mana.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Beseech the Mirror (using Badlands + Chrome Mox for BB, hold priority and crack LED for BBB, discarding hand), bargain Chrome Mox. This tutors for any card with mana value 4 or less and casts it for free, enabling a powerful combo turn.
